csv_scope_of_work: The City of Yukon is soliciting sealed proposals from qualified professional planning and economic development consulting firms to prepare a comprehensive Downtown Master Plan and Strategic Economic Development Framework for the City of Yukon, Oklahoma. The selected consultant shall provide all professional services, technical analysis, stakeholder engagement, economic modeling, and planning expertise necessary to develop a long-range, implementation-ready Downtown Master Plan that establishes a clear redevelopment vision, defines downtown boundaries, identifies catalytic opportunity sites, integrates economic development strategy, and provides actionable implementation guidance. The selected consultant shall provide comprehensive professional services to complete the Downtown Yukon Master Plan and Strategic Economic Development Framework. At a minimum, the scope of services shall include the following components: 1. Downtown Boundary Definition & District Framework The consultant shall evaluate and define the geographic boundaries of Downtown Yukon. This shall include analysis and recommendation of: Downtown Core Transition Areas Commercial Corridors Retail Activation Zones Housing-Supportive Areas Railroad and easement impact areas The consultant shall provide defensible mapping, character area descriptions, and startto-finish corridor definitions. 2. Existing Conditions Assessment The consultant shall conduct a comprehensive assessment of existing downtown conditions, including: Land use and zoning review Building inventory and vacancy analysis Floodplain constraints Parking supply assessment Public realm conditions Streetscape and connectivity analysis 3. Catalytic Redevelopment Planning The consultant shall develop redevelopment strategies for catalytic opportunity sites, including but not limited to: Flour Mill site Grain elevator properties Underutilized or obsolete industrial parcels This work shall include: Adaptive reuse vs demolition evaluation Conceptual redevelopment scenarios Phasing strategy General infrastructure considerations 4. Urban Design & Public Realm Framework The consultant shall develop design concepts for: Streetscapes Civic gathering spaces Public art integration Trail and park connectivity Design concepts shall be limited to priority locations identified in coordination with City staff. 5. Fiscal & Financial Analysis The consultant may provide high-level fiscal context to support redevelopment strategies. Detailed financial modeling and funding strategies are not required. 6. Zoning & Regulatory Alignment The consultant shall provide recommendations regarding: Zoning code modernization Downtown overlay district feasibility Development standards modernization Parking regulation modernization Adaptive reuse regulatory adjustments Alignment with future Comprehensive Plan update 7. Community & Stakeholder Engagement The consultant shall design and implement a structured engagement process, including: Stakeholder interviews Business and property owner meetings Small public input sessions Workshop facilitation Steering committee coordination (if established) 8. Implementation & Phasing Strategy The consultant shall develop a detailed implementation framework including: Immediate Actions (0 2 years) Short-Term Actions (3 5 years) Mid-Term Strategy (6 10 years) Long-Term Vision (20-year positioning) The final plan shall include a prioritized action matrix identifying responsible parties and sequencing guidance. The consultant shall identify known environmental considerations using publicly available information where readily accessible.

title: Downtown Yukon Master Plan
short_description: Consulting services for a downtown master plan and economic development framework in Yukon, Oklahoma.
project_scope: Preparation of a comprehensive downtown master plan and strategic economic development framework for the City of Yukon. Scope includes defining downtown boundaries and district framework; assessing existing conditions such as land use, zoning, building inventory, vacancy, floodplain constraints, parking, public realm, streetscape, and connectivity; developing redevelopment strategies for catalytic sites including the flour mill site, grain elevator properties, and underutilized industrial parcels; preparing conceptual redevelopment scenarios, phasing, and infrastructure considerations; urban design concepts for streetscapes, civic spaces, public art, trails, and park connectivity; zoning and regulatory recommendations; stakeholder engagement; and an implementation strategy from 0 to 20 years.
services: Professional planning and economic development consulting services, including master planning, redevelopment planning, urban design, stakeholder engagement, technical analysis, economic modeling, civil engineering input, surveying/GIS/mapping, transportation planning, and regulatory alignment.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a downtown master planning and economic development consultancy.
- Focus is urban planning, zoning, stakeholder engagement, and implementation strategy rather than structural engineering.
- No specific bridge, roof, special structure, or building design services are tendered.
- Falls under pure urban/open space planning, which is explicitly not a target area for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The document concerns planning and strategy services only, with no defined building or infrastructure project scope that would allow a realistic construction cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is a planning and economic development consultancy rather than a structural engineering assignment, an sbp fee cannot be realistically derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified professional planning and economic development consulting firms are requested. No specific minimum reference counts or structural engineering qualifications are stated in the source excerpt.
contracting_authority: City of Yukon, OK; Contact: Damien Denmark; Phone: 405-350-3931; Email: ddenmark@yukonok.gov; Website: https://www.yukonok.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=41
notes: RFP/RFQ; contract duration 12 months; not renewable. Disciplines requested include interior design/space planning, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, housing and urban development, land use planning, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, transportation planning, urban studies/planning/design, and graphic design/public art. Although a category must be assigned, the tender is essentially an urban planning/master planning project rather than a building or structural design commission.
